verdict.rationale: Fireworks explicitly documents itself as a drop-in replacement using the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API (docs-1,11,15,27,36), and a live probe confirms the OpenAI-style /v1/models endpoint is functioning at api.fireworks.ai (probe-rt-1), supporting seamless mid-workflow provider swaps without code changes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on agent-switching test (e.g. LangChain/agent framework confirming no code changes needed) and a public OpenAPI spec (probe-3 shows 404s for openapi.json).
